risk_if_not_implemented: Without AI & Autonomous Technologies Stakeholder Feedback Integration, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unintended or Unsafe Technology Behavior (R-AI-5), AI Bias / Discriminatory Outcome (R-AI-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Conflict of Interest (COI) / Undue Influence / Insider Misconduct (MT-15).

compensating_control_1.name: Third-Party Management
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of third-party management controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Third-Party Management (TPM-02) provides third-party oversight that compensates for the absence of AI & Autonomous Technologies Stakeholder Feedback Integration (AAT-33.1) by extending security obligations contractually and monitoring third-party risk in lieu of direct control. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Contacts With Groups & Associations
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to establish contact with selected groups and associations within the security, compliance and resilience communities to: 
(1) Facilitate ongoing cybersecurity and data protection education and training for organizational personnel;
(2) Maintain currency with recommended cybersecurity and data protection practices, techniques and technologies; and
(3) Share current cybersecurity and/or data protection-related information including threats, vulnerabilities and incidents.
compensating_control_2.justification: Contacts With Groups & Associations (GOV-16) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of AI & Autonomous Technologies Stakeholder Feedback Integration (AAT-33.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
